2-030|002.note: KEYING REQUIRED. This is a two-column glossary set as a caption, and much the densest Tier-1 material in the whole store. I have transcribed the left column entire, then the right column, because a caption text field cannot hold two columns; the physical lines pair across. At sheet scale I cannot separate ɪ from i, ê from e, or the two superscripts reliably, and several forms above are a best reading rather than a resolved one — the caption wants a dedicated read at the raster. The compass diagram above the title carries its own rotated labels (t-arkɪčhawe…, am-gɪnoˊt-aᵋl…, tɪleˊhtɪ neˊlyiᵋ, eulkeˊtyiᵋ, and an S at the foot); those are picture, and I have not transcribed them. In the right column, the form I have keyed t-arkɪčhaweˊu carries a final letter set heavier than the surrounding type, which I could not identify as any catalogued sort.
